_comment: The third-party ops' device legs (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 11 item 4.4, 26 Oct 2026), on one RunPod L4: cuda_gate runs every leg of tools/colab_cuda_validate.sh, now with tests/test_thirdparty_ops.cpp on the device (RoPE NEOX/partial and repeat_heads kernels bit for bit against the host loops, rmsnorm_group's, gradchecks, the llama block with the options). tp_device trains tests/test_thirdparty_ir.py's five models with the CUDA mtstudio and its device op set, exports, and checks numpy's IR forward over each GGUF against the device mtstudio's score (ROUNDING, greedy 40/40), so a model trained on the device reproduces in the IR. Independent jobs, run in order.

jobs.name: tp_device
cmd: python3 -m pip install -q pytest numpy > {out}/pip.log 2>&1; mkdir -p build_cuda && cd build_cuda && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DMICROTORCH_CUDA=ON > {out}/tp_configure.log 2>&1 && make mtstudio ir_eval -j"$(nproc)" > {out}/tp_build.log 2>&1 && cd .. && MTSTUDIO_BIN=$PWD/build_cuda/mtstudio MICROTORCH_DEVICE=cuda MICROTORCH_DEVICE_OPS=1 python3 -m pytest -q -s tests/test_thirdparty_ir.py -k export_and_numpy > {out}/tp_device.log 2>&1
